checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly labeled and is not used as a redline, survey, title, approval, or engineering basis; all affected metrics must be recomputed when cleared official geometry arrives.
All three key areas are present as provisional constraints; announced text values and EPSG:4548 polygon recomputations are disclosed separately.
Land-use polygons close the provisional site without gaps or overlap, use permitted formal enums, and remain proposal geometry rather than approved controls.
Paired Chinese and English static HTML visualizations contain ten paired figures, twelve scenarios, task coverage, sources, assumptions, and metrics without external dependencies.
Proposal maps 23 announcement and agent tasks, 6 mandatory standards, and 15 design-depth items to geometry, metrics, sources, assumptions, figures, and risks.
